# Waystar to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 2, 2026


Published on **October 14, 2026**


LEHI, Utah, and LOUISVILLE, Ky., October 14, 2026 —


**** Waystar Holding Corp. (Nasdaq: WAY), a provider of leading healthcare payment software, today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after market close on Monday, November 2, 2026. The company will discuss its financial results on a conference call at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time that same day.


A live audio webcast of the conference call will be available on Waystar’s investor relations website at


[https://investors.waystar.com/news-events/events](https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fprotect.checkpoint.com%2Fv2%2F___https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.waystar.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents___.YzJ1OnBhdWxiYWtlcm5vdGlmaWVkY29tOmM6bzpjMzk5ZWJmODkxYmQ0OWFmMGNkYmEwMzkzMzAxMmU5ZTo2OmRlY2Q6MjMzNjNkOTQ0YzFmYjZhYmFkYzU4MzcwMTE0MTQ5ZDJjN2EyMjY0ODkxNjJiMWIzNDU0YTQyYWVkM2U3MDQwZDpoOlQ6Tg&data=05%7C02%7Csandy.draper%40waystar.com%7C9b77aae10e4c44b987e608dca298179a%7C694d51c629114cbabfb42ce4062ec881%7C1%7C0%7C638564022970414948%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Z5Ia4Va6KfCtwy5fT3zVLE4oJo28iYQl0FWzOrMNi1w%3D&reserved=0) .


The webcast will be archived on the site for those unable to listen in real time.


**About Waystar**


Waystar’s mission-critical software is purpose-built to simplify healthcare payments so providers can prioritize patient care and optimize their financial performance. Waystar serves over 30,000 clients, representing over 1 million distinct providers, including 16 of 20 institutions on the U.S. News Best Hospitals list. Waystar’s enterprise-grade platform annually processes over 7.5 billion healthcare payment transactions, including over $2.4 trillion in annual gross claims and spanning approximately 60% of U.S. patients and one in three U.S. hospital discharges. Waystar strives to transform healthcare payments so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Discover the way forward at


[waystar.com](https://www.waystar.com/) .
